name: Israel Innovation Authority · Tnufa
amount: Up to NIS 200,000; up to 80% of approved costs.
fit: Early technological R&D; genuine novelty, applicant eligibility, matching funds and IP obligations need verification.

Monitor the program page for its next cycle; before preparing, verify the applicant route, novelty, budget and IP obligations. General website development alone is not a sufficient R&D case.

name: Israel Innovation Authority · Pre-Seed
amount: Up to NIS 2 million, subject to program terms.
fit: Potentially relevant only if an Israeli-incorporated company is pursuing commercial R&D and meets the track's financing, prior-funding and revenue limits. Talk2Nature's applicant entity and eligibility are unconfirmed.
next_action: The official program page now lists November 9, 2026 at 12:00 Israel time. It requires an Israeli-incorporated company focused on commercial R&D, at least 15% recognized investment commitments, and at least 75% of the requested round for R&D; prior funding and revenue caps also apply. No company or investor facts are confirmed. Verify all criteria before preparing anything.

name: NLnet · Restack
fit: Restack supports open internet infrastructure and foundational technologies; NLnet explicitly excludes AI-related projects except those already used by over one million people and directly relevant to the stack. Talk2Nature is an early animal-behavior/AI project, not internet infrastructure.
next_action: Do not prepare for this cycle on Talk2Nature's current scope. NLnet also says its GenAI policy is being revised and advises projects that use LLMs to wait for the new policy; mostly LLM-generated work is currently ineligible. Reassess only if a distinct, genuinely aligned infrastructure deliverable emerges and the policy is clear.
application_status: Not submitted; not recommended for current scope

name: NLnet · CodeSupply
fit: CodeSupply funds free/open-source work on software-package metadata for provenance, licensing, vulnerabilities, security and compliance. Talk2Nature's current research catalog is about biological literature and data, not software supply-chain datasets.
next_action: Do not prepare an application for this cycle unless a distinct deliverable directly advances CodeSupply's package-metadata objectives. The call requires the funded output to be open source; review the updated GenAI policy before any future proposal.
application_status: Not submitted; no aligned work package identified
